div.head: Northu 12
div.ab: Gif preost on unriht ut of scire had begite, gilde XII ór, ⁊ diacon VI ór; ⁊ þolian his hades, buton scirebiscop heom hades geunne.
If a priest wrongly obtain ordination outside the diocese, he is to pay 12 ores, and a deacon six ores; and each is to lose his orders unless the bishop of the diocese acknowledges the ordination.

If the priest wrongfully receives ordination outside of his diocese, he is to pay 12 ores and a deacon 6 ores; and he is to forfeit his ordination unless the bishop of the diocese allows the ordination.

Wenn ein Priester unrechtmässig, ausserhalb der Diöcese, die Weihe nimmt, zahle er 12 Ör, und ein Diakon 6 Ör; und sie sollen [jeder diese] seine Weihe verlieren, wenn ihnen nicht der Diöcesanbischof die Weihe belassen will.

If a priest wrongfully obtains ordination outside the diocese, let him pay 12 ores, and a deacon 6 ores; and let them [each] lose his orders, unless the diocesan bishop grants them [to keep] their orders.
